meta.name: product-showcase-page
meta.description: Build a single-product deep-dive showcase page as a self-contained HTML file. Triggers on: "build a product showcase page", "deep dive landing page for [product]", "create a product spotlight page", "product feature page", "single product page", "detailed page about [product]", "build a page showing everything about [product]", "create a long-form product page", "build a sales page for [product]", "product deep dive page", "make a feature breakdown page for [product]".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品创建深度展示销售页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让单个产品在网页上获得全面展示与解说
copy.tagline_en: Build a deep-dive sales page for a single product
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create a comprehensive showcase page for one product

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以生成一个包含英雄区、功能网格、用例、评价、价格对比、常见问题等的完整 HTML 产品展示页面，所有内容自带样式和交互。
howto.when: 当用户说出“产品展示页”、“深度介绍页”、“产品聚光灯页”等关键词，或要求为某个产品制作详尽页面时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 HeyGen 的产品展示页。
为 Semrush 创建一个价格优势角度的展示页，对比 Ahrefs。
say.note: 指定角度和竞品，Claude 会按需定制。

howto.what_en: Generates a self-contained HTML product showcase page with hero, features grid, use cases, testimonials, pricing comparison, FAQ accordion, and multiple CTAs, all inline CSS and JS.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user says phrases like "product showcase page", "deep dive landing page", "feature breakdown page", or asks for a detailed page about a product.

say_en.text: Build a product showcase page for HeyGen.
say_en.note: Claude researches HeyGen and produces the full page.

say_en.text: Create a price-value angle showcase page for Semrush, comparing with Ahrefs.
say_en.note: Custom angle and competitor comparison will be applied.
